subtitle: A quartz beach 16 km north of Kozhikode whose 1975 state monument declares Vasco da Gama "landed here" in 1498 — a claim the voyage's own logbook does not support.
spike_statement: Kappad's stone monument says Vasco da Gama "landed here" in 1498; the voyage's logbook puts his fleet offshore and his first step ashore further south.

levers.photo_tone: Late Arabian-Sea light off the west-facing sand, the low grey commemorative pillar in the foreground, a rocky temple-topped headland breaking the shoreline and the Korapuzha backwaters behind
